{{Quote|Raise an army? Bah! If you cannot afford mercenaries, trick your enemies into fighting each other!|Godoba the Shrewd|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>}}
'''Godoba''', known as '''Godoba the Hutt''' and '''Godoba the Shrewd''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and leader of the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He decided to support the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in exchange for a mission from an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] against holdings of the [[Exchange]]. He was also the owner of the [[Club Vertica Casino]] and five [[City/Legends|city]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="TOR" />
